executive_summary: Independent six-check review of the 23 Nov 2026 09:11:15 ET freeze (candidate 7c3a163d): the bytes hash to candidate.sha256, canonical(data/current.json) equals the same digest, structural-flags.json is [], publish.py --check reports a valid structure, and the worktree is clean. Official policy reproduces on the primaries: the Fed held 3-3/4 to 4 percent on 28 Oct by 10-2 with Cook and Hammack preferring +1/4, 'inflation remains elevated', 'expanding at a strong pace' (federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm); the October minutes record that almost all participants saw further increases as likely appropriate and that a couple floated more than 25bp (fomcminutes20261028.htm, released 18 Nov); the BoC raised 25bp to 2.5% with Bank Rate 2.75% and deposit 2.45%, CPI 'about 3.5%' by year-end and 3% average in 2027, and kept 'there could be a need to increase the policy rate further' (bankofcanada.ca/2026/10/fad-press-release-2026-10-28/); the 10 Nov deliberations carry the pass-through and broad-based-risk language, and the Q3 SLOS valet series prints business -6.48 vs -1.04 and mortgage -26.27 vs +0.64 (price -52.55, non-price 0.00). Pricing reproduces exactly at the frozen minute on both Kalshi ladders (Fed 0.02/0.03, 0.92/0.93, 0.03/0.04, 0.00/0.01 at 14:11Z; BoC 0.00/0.01, 0.47/0.49, 0.50/0.55 at 14:11Z) and on Polymarket (0.460 at 14:05Z), and BlueGamma is quoted correctly (Fed 99%/+25bp, BoC 60%/+15bp, 'As of 23 Nov 2026', forward table 'Last update: 20 Nov 2026'). The blocking problem is post-snapshot repricing on the BoC book: between 09:15 and 09:24 ET the Kalshi hike bucket went 47.5 -> 58.0 and the hold bucket 51.5 -> 41.0 (1,000-contract trade at 14:17Z), while Polymarket's 25bp increase went 0.460 -> 0.580 by 14:18Z, so the venue leader has flipped from hold to hike; that is a >10pp move on the bucket the dashboard leads with, and the notes' 'BoC book has given back about 10 points since Friday' plus the 'hold' band now describe a market that no longer exists. Fed pricing moved only 95.5 -> ~95 and stays inside tolerance. Drivers, scoring and age decay check out (parts sum to weight, mean |weight| 2.3, no driver older than the last meeting, no weight >=5 needing numeric validation), and spot checks of the market-validation numbers reproduce (Waller 10 Nov 0.805 -> 0.885 between 09:00Z and 10:00Z; 6 Nov BoC 0.305 mid at 14:13Z). REVISE: re-freeze after 09:20 ET with the repriced BoC ladder, rewrite the BoC narrative and the 9 December calendar row to match, and fix the two small driver blemishes (August control-group revision stated as both 1.6/1.4 and 1.5/1.3; Williams link labelled via Reuters but pointing at investing.com).
